title: Interactive Data
source_verification_depth: Complete Supporting Statement A plus package; underlying cited sources not all independently retrieved. Specific corroboration recorded separately.

score_rationale.reproducibility: Filers, frequency and response hours reproduce rounded total.
score_rationale.provenance: Administrative filing estimate; unit burden and purchased-service rate not supported with precise evidence.

score_rationale.item13: Software and filing cost per response disclosed but unit price is not sourced.
score_rationale.item14: Item 14 explicitly defers estimates while SEC revises its methodology; this is missing, not zero.
score_rationale.item15: Prior/current responses, hours and nonlabor costs reconcile exactly.
score_rationale.validation: Agency experience rather than measured timing; estimates explicitly for PRA.
score_rationale.consistency: Displayed averages reproduce totals within rounding and change arithmetic is exact.

item14.status: Explicitly deferred pending revised agency methodology

assumptions: 53.11111 hours per filing, 6175 dollars software/filing service, 4.5 filings per respondent.

reconstruction_issues: Labor cost is not monetized in Item 12.
Item 14 explicitly postpones the estimate, so federal cost cannot be reconstructed.
Purchased software/service unit price lacks an accessible empirical basis in the statement.
methods_worth_testing: Keep concise, exact old/new change tables; distinguish omitted estimates from legitimate zeros.
